prompts: Create ONE animation contact sheet, exactly TWO columns by FOUR rows = EIGHT consecutive frames in reading order, no gutters, no panel borders, no labels. Canvas 1280x1440, each panel 640x360 16:9. Strict 1990s CPS2/Neo Geo PIXEL ART at native resolution: crisp stepped pixel clusters, bold dark contours, flat 2-3 tone shading, muted restrained colors, same limited palette in all frames. NOT smooth illustration, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradients, no text, no watermarks. Every panel is a fully opaque finished cinematic frame. Coherent same subjects and background, small incremental motion from frame to frame. Do not change camera unless requested. OPENING C7. Eight clearly repeated consecutive views of a brass elevator interior seen through opening doors, NO PEOPLE. Frames1-2 the brass doors slide apart to reveal a bronze control panel on the right interior wall. Frames3-8 camera looks increasingly downward along this impossibly long narrow panel, two vertical columns of perfectly BLANK ROUND BUTTONS continue beneath bottom frame. Row after row glows warm amber in a fast descending sequence. At least 12-16 large blank round buttons per panel, no printed numbers or icons or lettering at all. Same dark green bronze interior and brass edges in every view. Quiet uncanny infinite depth. Crisp limited-palette pixel art. Distinct 2-column4-row grid of eight cinematic shots, no margins or gutters, no white flash.

EDIT this eight-panel 2-column4-row pixel-art sheet. Preserve every panel's camera, architecture and exact button positions. Change ONLY which blank button lights are illuminated: panel1 remains closed doors. Panel2 ONLY top pair lit amber, all lower buttons DARK gray-green. Panel3 top TWO pairs lit, rest dark. Panel4 top THREE pairs lit, rest dark. Panel5 top FOUR pairs lit, bottom pairs dark. Panel6 top FIVE pairs lit, bottom pair dark. Panel7 all pairs except lowest visible pair lit. Panel8 all visible pairs lit. This must clearly show an amber activation wave moving down the rows, rather than all buttons illuminated from the start. Unlit buttons stay clearly visible by their brass rims and dark centers. ALL buttons blank without digits. Keep image dimensions, eight-frame grid and bold PIXEL ART treatment exactly. No new objects, no people.
